description: Source code for an IDM server component implementing UPnP service interactions, device XML updates, and network configuration functions.

methods.name: check_empty_idm
methods.description: Checks if the provided string is non-empty.

methods.name: check_null_idm
methods.description: Checks if the provided string pointer is not NULL.

methods.name: get_bcastmacaddress_cb
methods.description: Callback to set the broadcast MAC address in UPnP service.

methods.name: query_bcastmacaddress_cb
methods.description: Query callback to retrieve broadcast MAC address.

methods.name: get_client_ip_cb
methods.description: Callback to set the client IP in UPnP service.

methods.name: query_client_ip_cb
methods.description: Query callback to retrieve client IP.

methods.name: get_gwyipv6_cb
methods.description: Callback to set the gateway IPv6 address.

methods.name: query_gwyipv6_cb
methods.description: Query callback to retrieve gateway IPv6 address.

methods.name: get_account_id_cb
methods.description: Callback to set the account ID in UPnP service.

methods.name: query_account_id_cb
methods.description: Query callback to retrieve account ID.

methods.name: open_document
methods.description: Opens and parses an XML document from a file.

methods.name: set_content
methods.description: Sets the content of a specified XML node.

methods.name: updatexmldata
methods.description: Updates specific fields in an XML device description file.

methods.name: free_server_memory
methods.description: Frees allocated server resources and objects.

methods.name: getUidfromRecvId
methods.description: Generates a UUID based on broadcast MAC address tokens.

methods.name: getUUID
methods.description: Retrieves the UUID, either from received ID or generated.

methods.name: idm_server_start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the IDM server, setting up UPnP contexts and services.
